description: Checkpoint for the Daily Code Review routine. Records the last commit on the default branch (main) that has been reviewed. The next run diffs main from this SHA forward. Update after each run.

lastRun.notes:
4 commits / 13 files (~125 insertions, ~33 deletions). Zero tickets — nothing in the diff cleared the bar, and the substantive changes are all other-routine territory per guardrails 3 and 5.

The four commits:
- 20ca564 (#1501) chore(devex): clear DevEx backlog (ADS-1355..1360) — turbo.json lint inputs now include the shared eslint-config packages (correct: lint outputs depend on those configs, so they belong in the cache key), package.json test:e2e:single wired to `playwright test` (was a dupe of test:e2e), and the docker.yml per-service paths-filter (ADS-1357) so a PR only rebuilds+Trivy-scans the service images a change can actually affect. DevEx/CI territory.
- 33d28d8 (#1500) docs: fix native-dev REDIS_PORT guidance 6380->6379 (ADS-1354) — .env.example + docs/env-reference.md doc correction (native dev:services publishes 6379; the 6380 remap is docker:dev-overlay only). Also corrected a stale APPLICATIONS_GRPC_URL example port. Docs.
- 85e8995 (#1499) ci(workspace-drift): wire check:permission-casts and check:workflow-pinning into CI (ADS-1353) — promotes two ci:local-only guards into the CI job. CI/DevEx territory.
- 7db2a52 (#1498) chore(review): the previous run's own checkpoint commit (ADS-1351/1352 bookkeeping).

Reviewed the full diff by hand. No application or service business-logic code changed: no gRPC handlers, routes, SQL, React components/hooks, or types. The turbo.json/package.json edits are correct and low-risk; the docker.yml filter is a sound CI-cost optimization (deny-by-omission is safe here because push/schedule/dispatch still build+scan every service, and the packages/* rebuild list was cross-checked against services/*/package.json in the commit's own comments). Nothing to flag as a code-review defect in product code.

Overlap check (guardrail 3): no candidate findings this run, so no Linear query was needed. Per guardrails 3 and 5, the DevEx-backlog/CI changes (ADS-1353/1355..1360) are the DevEx routine's territory and were left to it.
